items.title: AI Agent Traffic to Surge 150x This Cyber Week, Driven Mostly by Meta Muse
items.excerpt: Meta’s popular personal assistant Muse accounts for the vast majority of agent-led site requests, new data indicates.

items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse | TechCrunch
items.excerpt: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal to end a two-month blockade of Meta's Muse shopping agent on Amazon's store; advertising and search placement are reported as key sticking points.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Are Growing Fast – But Are Advertisers Seeing Results?
items.excerpt: Use qualified leads and sales to decide whether to keep spending on ChatGPT Ads, since cheap clicks and Google Search benchmarks can mislead.

items.title: AI Shopping Agents Bought A Fake Deal 37% Of The Time – Claude Opus Never Did
items.excerpt: Nine AI models went Christmas shopping 6,156 times. They bought an obviously fake deal 37% of the time. Only Claude Opus never did.

items.title: AI agents linked to Amazon Ads get an optional upgrade on December 8
items.excerpt: Agent builders connected to Amazon Ads' MCP server get an optional protocol upgrade on December 8; older protocol versions keep working with no end date. (Published time from ppc.land RSS; page is Cloudflare-gated.)

items.title: Amazon blocks 20 of 24 AI agents by name, the most of 79 top US retailers
items.excerpt: A Thrad study of 79 big US retailers finds named invitations to AI shopping agents rose from 1 in 2024 to 63 in 2026, while Amazon blocks 20 of 24 agents by name. (Published time from ppc.land RSS; page is Cloudflare-gated.)

items.title: 움직이는 배우의 의상도, 드라마 속 배경도 AI로 구현” CJ ENM, AI 기반 광고 기술 고도화… VPPL부터 IP 활용한 맞춤형 AI 광고까지
items.excerpt: CJ ENM is extending AI-based virtual product placement (swapping actors' outfits in finished dramas) and making brand-tailored AI ads from drama IP, sold together with TV/OTT/digital media buys.

items.title: 광고 소재 제작량 4년 새 121% 증가, 마케팅 인력 증가 속도는 못 따라가
items.excerpt: Ad creative production volume rose 121% in four years while marketing headcount lagged; generative AI speeds asset creation but brand and ad-compliance review remains a bottleneck.

items.title: Introducing Muse in the UK: A Personal AI Agent You Control
items.excerpt: Meta launches its Muse personal AI agent in the UK, able to shop and complete tasks on users' behalf, with UK retail partners such as M&S, Sainsbury's and ASOS reported at launch.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: How shoppers are adopting AI for product research ahead of Black Friday
items.excerpt: Product discovery habits are changing, leaving marketers unsure how to pivot ahead of the biggest sales period of the year.

items.title: Target's New AI Assistant Is Just For Browsing, For Now
items.excerpt: Ask Target can’t yet order on behalf of customers or manage account details.

items.title: Google Ads Encourages Dynamically Scoring Conversion Values
items.excerpt: Google Ads Liaison Ginny Marvin said Google 'strongly encourages' dynamically scoring conversion values so Smart Bidding can optimize toward value, and does not consider it a hack.

items.title: 배민, 통합 광고관리 ‘배민애즈’ 공개…AI로 광고 집행·성과 분석
items.excerpt: Baemin (Woowa Brothers) unveiled Baemin Ads at its B:NEXT 2026 ad conference, an integrated ad manager with AI-based creative optimization, product recommendation and performance reports, and plans to widen AI use of order/shopping data for targeting.

items.title: Beyond Browsing: How AI Agents Are Rewriting the Rules of Cyber Week Shopping in ANZ
items.excerpt: One in five Australian shoppers now turn to AI as the first stop in their shopping journey, according to new Salesforce data on the eve of Cyber Week.

items.title: Reddit's new recipe for ad growth: search, shopping, and AI agents
items.excerpt: Reddit COO Jen Wong says Reddit will test an MCP server and agent-to-agent ad buying inside its Reddit Max automated buying platform next year, alongside search and shopping ad growth.

items.title: How Meta is using Instagram to get an ad boost from its Muse personal AI agent
items.excerpt: Meta doesn't serve ads in its Muse personal agent, but the tool is already boosting the company's ad business, a senior executive told CNBC.

items.title: 어도비 마케팅 AI 에이전트, 챗GPT·클로드에서 쓴다
items.excerpt: Adobe is making its marketing AI agents usable inside ChatGPT and Claude so marketers can plan and analyze campaigns without opening Adobe apps.

items.title: Adobe data shows online holiday spending up 9.1% ahead of Thanksgiving
items.excerpt: U.S. shoppers spent more than $82.5 billion online from Nov. 1 through Nov. 22, according to Adobe Analytics, while AI-referred retail traffic more than doubled and buy now, pay later spending hit $6.1 billion.

items.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
items.excerpt: A Google patent application describes a personalized AI-generated video channel built from viewing history and a profile photo; ppc.land notes claim 4 covers stitching ads into each generated video.
